title: Find a transaction on an account by its amount
description: Signs on to ParaBank, searches one account's transactions for an exact amount, and returns the first match's date and description.
goal: Sign on, find the transactions of exactly {{inputs.amount}} on account {{inputs.accountId}}, and read the date and description of the first one found.

amount.description: an amount in dollars and cents, without the $

transactionDate.description: the date of the first transaction found

transactionDescription.description: the description of the first transaction found

probes.why: an amount with no transactions on this account
